ideas.title: We live on someone
ideas.critique: It is the direct next step of the drift (a whole-island motion event with a crew reacting and a line at the end), so the shape is familiar. The revelation that the ground is a living creature, with breathing terrain, is a real change to what the island is and would be shown to a friend, if the breathing stays visible and is not just one head cameo.

ideas.title: The sea turns to glass
ideas.critique: A change of the world's own material that reveals the underside is new to the posts, and it does serve the path tracing goal. It overlaps the earlier 'Under the island' pitch and the pond glass work, and fish schools plus caustics are the expected content. The raster and browser will not show it, so it is mostly a traced film.

ideas.title: What lives under us
ideas.critique: This is judged again as sharpened: the hidden simulation is shown through an instrument, and the huge shape at the end is a good mystery beat. It still ends as a pier prop with a screen, Gloop reacts with a shout, and the sonar sound cannot be checked here. It is the same recipe as the board that shows a tool's readout.

ideas.title: The island remembers being drawn
ideas.critique: Showing the game's own development history inside the world, with grey-box patches that turn friends into old blobs, is radical and new to the posts. The roaming patches resemble the drifting rings of Slow time and the ghosts of Yesterday in mechanics. Strong, since it needs the old looks to be recreated well enough to read.

ideas.title: Undo the day
ideas.critique: Replaying real logged poses is what Yesterday already did, here sped up and reversed with a gathering on the beach. A backwards sun, paint and pumpkins make a fun film, but the recipe is a recurring replay event with a small ritual, and the rewind key already exists.

ideas.title: Two of me
ideas.critique: The second game instance appearing in the world as a doubled Lumi is a clever meta turn that no earlier post has done, and it makes real use of the two-games setup. It builds on the paper boat and the mirror island, and the double is close to the runaway shadow and reflection gags. The argument over who is real is the payoff to watch.
